statewide_source.service: TN Comptroller Office of Property Assessment 'IMPACT' Parcel_Layer_Themes (layer 12 'Parcels'), served by maps.cot.tn.gov, no token needed
statewide_source.county_filter: COUNTY_ID = <1..95 alphabetical county number> (e.g. 30 = Greene; ignore ~7.7k rows with null COUNTY_ID and a few with 0/13800/32767)

fields.deed_ref: DEEDBKPG (last-sale deed as 'book/page', e.g. 1839/2277, R1000/I755, RB167/714; blank for ~25-60% of parcels)
fields.pid: PARCELID (e.g. '001 099C C 00800 000 2027'; GISLINK is the same ID without jurisdiction/year)

statewide_source.coverage: 86 of 95 counties. NOT in layer (not maintained by the Comptroller): Chester, Davidson, Hamilton, Hickman, Knox, Montgomery, Rutherford, Shelby, Williamson.
statewide_source.caveat: Service is state-internal ('IMPACT', edit capabilities exposed); the officially published public layer is the AGOL 'Tennessee Property Boundaries Public Use' item (below) which has owner + PARCELID but NO deed/plat. Comptroller also offers weekly per-county shapefile downloads (Assessment_Data table joins by GISLINK).

_meta.geometry_layer_9_nonmaintained: https://geoviewer.cot.tn.gov/arcgis/rest/services/GeoViewer/NonImpact_Parcels/MapServer/<layer> (Davidson 1, Hamilton 2, Knox 3, Montgomery 4, Rutherford 5, Shelby 6, Williamson 8, Chester 9, Hickman 10; geometry+GISLINK only except Knox which carries owner+deed)

fields.pid: none (TDOT project points, not NGS PIDs)
fields.coordinates: DD_LATITUDE/DD_LONGITUDE, DMS_*, NORTHING/EASTING _M/_FT (D.A. = datum-adjusted, DA_FACTOR), HORZ_DATUM

sources.datasheet: No per-station URL. Record itself carries the description; query where FILENAME='{FILENAME}' or POINTNAME='{POINTNAME}'. TDOT Geodetic Control app (tn.gov/tdot/engineering-division/geodetics/geodetic-control.html) has a Data Sheet button.
sources.caution: Coordinates are TDOT datum-adjusted project values (NAD83(1995)), not raw NAD83(2011). Stored as published; no shift applied.

control.other: TDOT GNSS Reference Network station CSV on tn.gov (Sept 2026 adjustment) - CORS-type, network access is paid.

ngs.note: NGS covers all states; PID links state records to NGS datasheets. Not re-surveyed here.

control.data_year: live 2026 (TDOT service; newest marks sampled were set 2025)

roads.name: Tennessee NG911 Road Centerlines
roads.agency: Tennessee Emergency Communications Board (TN ECB) and local 911 districts; hosted by TN OIR GIS (tnmap_oir)
roads.layer: Tennessee NG911 Road Centerlines (layer id 1, not 0)
roads.non_tn_note: ~70 edge segments tagged with neighboring-state counties (Bristol VA, Calloway/Fulton/Allen KY, Catoosa/Dade GA, etc.) and 3 blank; filter COUNTY_L to the 95 TN names.
roads.county_filter: COUNTY_L or COUNTY_R = uppercase county name (e.g. 'WARREN', 'VAN BUREN'); all 95 TN counties present (smallest Trousdale 844)
roads.route_note: NG911 has no route number field. For SR/US/Interstate numbers use the TDOT Road Segment layer (alt_sources[0]: NBR_RTE, RTE_NME, SR_DESIGNATION, NBR_US_RTE..._6, FUNC_CLASS).
roads.vintage: AGOL item modified 2026-10-06; latest ATTDATE 2026-09-24. GEODATE has junk outliers (years 0123/3023), ignore for vintage.
